title: rest.users.list.response
description: GET /api/users response: every user of this vault (protocol 1.8).

id.description: The user's id: the slug of the name given at creation, with a numeric suffix when that slug is taken; a later rename never changes it.

name.description: The student's name as they write it, trimmed: 1 to 80 characters, not blank.

email.description: Contact email; absent when the user has none.

photo_url.description: Path of the profile photo, served by GET /api/users/{user_id}/photo; absent when the user has none.
